props.name: src
props.description: Image to convert. Same-origin, or CORS-enabled — the canvas has to read it.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture is. The ASCII is decorative; this is the alt text.

props.name: columns
props.description: Characters across. Height follows the aspect ratio.

props.name: ramp
props.description: Darkest to lightest. The first character is used for black.

props.name: invert
props.description: Invert, for light art on a dark background.

props.name: colored
props.description: Colour each character from the source pixel instead of one flat colour.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the glyphs.
